_note: Official service directory, checked against the linked pages on 2026-10-18. Council tax links are council-specific: find any council at https://www.gov.uk/find-local-council.

dvla_licence.service: Change the address on your driving licence
what_customer_needs: photo ID if asked to prove identity

dvla_v5c.service: Change the address on your vehicle log book (V5C)

council_tax_old.service: Tell your old council you are moving out
council_tax_old.note: Demo customer's old council (Leeds). For other customers use their council's move-out page.

council_tax_new.service: Register for council tax with your new council
what_customer_needs: names of all adults living there
council_tax_new.note: Demo customer's new council (North Yorkshire). For other customers use their council's move-in page.

council_tax_same_council.service: Tell your council you are moving within its area
what_customer_needs: names of all adults at the new address
council_tax_same_council.note: One change of address, not a move out and a move in. Find the council's own change-of-address page from gov.uk's council finder.

electoral_register.service: Register to vote at your new address
what_customer_needs: National Insurance number (you can still register without one)
which database the chip is registered on (check-a-chip.co.uk)
